title: Everything Has a Place

voice.name: Rocco
voice.model: Veo native dialogue (veo-3.1-generate-001), isolated and re-voiced with eleven_multilingual_sts_v2

lines.note: PLAN: picks up the hammer from the workbench, tilts his head at it
PLAN: points a teal wingtip at the empty hammer outline on the pegboard beside him
PLAN: steps back, wingtips on hips, beams. Must END by ~6.8s so the clip has an eyes-open hold for the tail start.

signoff.note: Shared audio/signoffs/signoff_rocco.mp3, trimmed speech 2.09s, natural speed. Tail SPEAKING window 0.3-2.4s to match. at = cut point + tail mouth onset.

video.description: ROCCO (refs/characters/rocco_ref.png): a cheerful tall cartoon rooster with an orange-red body, a long neck and a red face, big round expressive eyes with blue irises, a large yellow beak, a red comb and wattle, golden-yellow scalloped neck and chest feathers, a large curved teal-turquoise tail, teal wingtips he gestures with like hands, yellow legs and feet, and a woven straw farmer's hat with a red band. No kerchief. In the workshop (refs/locations/workshop.png). A pegboard hangs on the wall right beside him at wing height, its tools each hung inside a painted outline (a wrench, a screwdriver, pliers, a saw) and ONE empty hammer-shaped outline. NO hammer on the pegboard. ONE wooden hammer lies on the workbench in front of him: the only hammer in the picture.

beats.action: Rocco picks up the hammer from the workbench in one teal wingtip, tilts his head at it and says the line.
Still facing camera, he points his other wingtip at the empty hammer outline on the pegboard beside him and says the line.
Silent: he hangs the hammer inside its outline on the pegboard; it fits exactly.
He steps back, wingtips on hips, beams at camera and says the line.
Hold: proud smile facing camera, eyes open, mouth closed. The tail starts from a frame here and the main clip is cut at that frame.

notes: Pacing: 9 words + sign-off, gaps >= 0.7s, the silent hang is the lesson beat. Franchise: Rocco Knows. Teaches: putting things back where they belong. Distinct from Shorts 2 (intro), 9 (checklist), 11 (what sound), 15 (stop look listen). New PLAYBOOK (PR #12): still continuity check (exactly one hammer, none on the pegboard), last line done by ~6.8s then hold, tail window = sign-off length, sign-off = shared recording, audio steps at 1 generation.
